title: Youth Mental Health and Well-Being in an Uncertain World
discussion_signal: The post frames youth mental health as an ecosystem of economic uncertainty, conflict, climate change, inequality, digital life, education, work, housing, culture, and agency. It shifts the conversation from individual treatment toward the conditions surrounding young people.
linked_research_question: How do surrounding social and institutional conditions shape youth mental health, connection, and agency?
limits: No independent youth sample is visible in the post
The post does not establish intervention effects
